Market today: Mixed bag. Rising 10-year Treasury yields are a drag on growth/tech, but chip names like Nvidia are showing strong individual performance. This creates conflicting signals for your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-26.08%) and SPAL (-26.66%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, deep in the red, and flagged "SELL." Their listed stops are above current prices, suggesting they've been breached or need immediate re-evaluation, especially with margin amplifying losses.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield for broader market direction. Also, watch for continued strength or weakness in the chip sector following Nvidia's move.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk on your leveraged, underperforming positions, as margin makes drawdowns extra painful.
plays: SOXL / SPAL: Your listed stops are blown. Re-evaluate your exit strategy for these leveraged "SELL" positions immediately to prevent further decay and margin calls.
SMH: With Nvidia hitting new highs, consider adding to SMH if it pulls back to 632.3-631.21, stop 628.93, to capitalize on chip sector strength.
CRWD: This is a strong performer. If CRWD dips to the scanner's entry (268.92-268.65) with a stop at 267.65, it could be an opportunity to add.
